label: Bible Study
prompt: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the _____ shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
note: Handel set this one to music — the Christmas prophecy, seven hundred years early.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your _____.
verse: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
note: The finding is guaranteed; the fine print is 'with all your heart.' Half-hearted need not apply.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the _____ of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
verse: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
note: David's answer to Goliath: sword, spear, and shield on one side; a name on the other.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Where there is no _____, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verse: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
note: 'Vision' here is prophetic revelation — without a word from God, a people unravels.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In my Father's house are many _____: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verse: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
note: 'Mansions' from the Latin mansio — a dwelling place. The KJV made heaven's real estate famous.
